title: Run Your Instagram Content with Claude: 7 Copy-and-Paste Prompts

slides.title: Run Your *Instagram* with Claude.
slides.sub: 7 AI prompts that make content creation easier.

slides.title: Give Claude your *brand brain.*
slides.why: Claude can’t guess your business. Give it context first.
slides.prompt: Act as my Instagram content strategist. My niche is [niche]. My audience is [audience]. My brand voice is [3 words]. My goal is [growth/leads/sales]. Use this context when creating content in this conversation.
slides.watch: Save it in a Claude Project’s instructions.

slides.title: Hooks that *stop the scroll.*
slides.why: Specific beats vague. Ask for 10, then pick the best.
slides.prompt: Write 10 Instagram hooks about [topic] for [audience]. Make them specific, curiosity-driven, and under 12 words. Avoid clickbait.

slides.title: Create *Reel scripts.*
slides.why: Hook, points, visuals and CTA in one request.
slides.prompt: Write a 30-second Instagram Reel script about [topic]. Include a strong hook, 3 useful points, visual directions, and a natural CTA.

slides.title: Create Instagram *carousels.*
slides.why: Headline, copy and visual direction for every slide.
slides.prompt: Create an 8-slide Instagram carousel about [topic]. Give each slide a headline, concise educational copy, and visual direction. End with a useful takeaway and CTA.

slides.title: Captions people *actually read.*
slides.why: Open strong. Give value. Ask for one action.
slides.prompt: Write an engaging Instagram caption about [topic] for [audience]. Use a strong opening, practical value, natural keywords, a clear CTA, and 3–5 relevant hashtags.

slides.title: Plan *30 days* of content.
slides.prompt: Create a 30-day Instagram content calendar for [niche]. Include topic, format, hook, audience benefit, and CTA. Balance tutorials, tips, examples, and community posts.

slides.title: Reply to comments *professionally.*
slides.prompt: Draft friendly, natural replies to these Instagram comments: [paste comments]. Match my brand voice. Keep replies concise, helpful, and personalized. Flag anything sensitive for manual review.
slides.watch: Claude drafts replies. It can’t access or post your Instagram comments without an integration you set up.
